The issuer displays strong operating profitability with an operating margin of 30% on revenue of $12.22B, backed by a solid gross margin of 72% and net income of $2.20B. However, its capital structure is highly leveraged, with total liabilities of $78.29B against shareholders' equity of $18.55B (a debt-to-equity leverage effect), and it maintains a relatively tight current ratio of 1.27. These factors indicate a highly profitable, large-scale investment-grade profile but with elevated leverage that constrains the rating to the single-A category.

DECISION: A-
